apk.nativeInstallScope: Native installation and play observations, with tested APK hash, are recorded separately in manual-verification.json.

scope: Extracted Korean data and 24,737 script instructions
Original-function differential fixtures for dice, new-game placement, navigation, supplies, combat, economics and script arithmetic
Independent navigation, trading, supply/unloading, shipyard, recruitment, appointments, equipment, contracts, gambling, battle, spoils and save/restore
Six original story endings with test-supplied travel, fame and battle prerequisites
Seven royal quest families, debt collection and actual A* sea travel
All 130 port arrivals and 889 building paths
Real-time battle movement, projectiles, ammunition, fleet AI, flagship duel and deterministic save/restore
Atomic game editor, speaker and attendant portraits, fleet hail reply and sea camera bounds
limits: Tests of story endings supply progression prerequisites; these are not six complete human playthroughs.
NPC global routing and offscreen combat use independent pathfinding and scheduling; they are not instruction-identical to the DOS runtime.
Original-function comparisons validate recorded inputs only, not every possible game state.
All 101 town layouts were reviewed in an overview gallery; exhaustive dialogue and form bounds were checked in a browser harness. This does not cover every device.
Versioned release validation records the exact browser and Android observations and their limits.

observations: Installed interim 1.0.4 and observed its version on the title screen and the editor item tab.
The user stopped computer use with Escape before final 1.0.5 installation verification. No further native interaction was attempted.

browser.method: Rendered application components, checked viewport bounds, portrait ratio and scroll reachability. Feature interactions used separate QA fixtures not included in the APK.
observations: Fleet hail displayed Simon and an actual reply about sailing toward Lisbon; back and close actions remained available.
Edited gold 100000 to 1234567, swordplay 53 to 99, and added a dagger. Reviewed three changes, applied them, then reloaded and reopened the autosave from the title editor.
At 390x844, held movement and fire together: player moved from (20,20) to (20,23.29), ammunition 40 to 39, enemy hull 200 to 199.
Saved and reloaded the live battle; position, ammunition and enemy damage were preserved.
At 844x390, dragged/held the aim control with movement: player moved to y=23.39 and fired two projectiles. Manual aim missed, as expected for that aim direction.
Approached the marked enemy flagship, requested a duel, and continued attack/defence inputs through a terminal defeat without getting stuck.
London church sign stayed in front of scenery; tapping it entered the church.
A two-speaker dialogue rendered vendor art for the shopkeeper and portrait 3 for the named speaker, without a Joao fallback.
Stockholm Anna rendered portrait 112; Ceuta Anna rendered portrait 106. Both were visually checked in their actual tavern dialogue popups.
Sea camera at 844x390 showed London/Bristol/Antwerp in the widest setting; the London entry action worked.
The sea zoom setting persisted after reload, and the 390x844 sea view switched from very wide to wide with the plus button.

limits: Final APK 1.0.5 was built, signed and checked byte-for-byte against the tested web assets; final native installation/play was not completed after computer use was stopped.
Geometry audits are automated checks, not a manual reading of all dialogue.
Battle/editor manual tests use QA fixtures. Story-ending tests supply prerequisites; no claim of six complete manual campaign playthroughs.
No physical Android phone was tested.
